sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks for
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: AMOLED dark theme
Replaces the dark theme background with pure black and can dim menus, bars and buttons.
Custom accent color
Changes the accent color. Choose a color in the patches menu.
Disable telemetry
Stops sending usage statistics and diagnostics to Proton.
Hide upgrade promotions
Hides settings that need a paid plan, upgrade banners, the Discover VPN Plus carousel and special offers.
Material 3 switches
Adds check and close icons to switches.
Remove server change delay
Removes the wait between server changes on free plans.
Show free server locations
Lists free server locations in Countries and Search and connects to the one you pick. Applies only to free plans.
Unlock connection preferences
Unlocks the default connection, recent connections and excluded locations on free plans.
Unlock custom DNS
Unlocks custom DNS on free plans.
Unlock LAN connections
Unlocks LAN connections on free plans.
Unlock NetShield
Unlocks NetShield ad and tracker blocking on free plans.
Unlock profiles
Unlocks profiles on free plans and limits them to free locations. Profiles for other locations are hidden.
Unlock split tunneling
Unlocks split tunneling on free plans.
